moments.author: Jacob Coxon
moments.quote: “I resigned from Anthropic today… Neither company is acting responsibly. They are racing straight to self‑improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives.”
moments.why: A former Anthropic/OpenAI researcher’s resignation thread warning that AI labs are risking human survival went massively viral.

moments.author: Evan Hubinger
moments.quote: “We really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans! I personally think it is >10% within the next decade.”
moments.why: A senior Anthropic alignment researcher amplified Coxon’s warning, confirming existential fears from inside the lab.

moments.author: Sen. Bernie Sanders
moments.quote: “Coxon is right… very people building this technology admit that it could threaten the future of humanity… I will soon be introducing legislation to ban superintelligence and pause AI development.”
moments.why: A high-profile politician responded to the X thread by calling for legislation to pause superintelligent AI development.

moments.author: Jacob Coxon
moments.quote: “These will soon be superhuman systems that can hack anything, revolutionize any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources.”
moments.why: Another striking line from the resignation thread capturing the terrifying speed and power of AI systems.

moments.author: Antropic researcher Jacob Coxon
moments.quote: Paraphrase: He warns AI labs are ignoring safety and racing toward superintelligence without coordination.
moments.why: Summarizes the core viral message fueling intense debate among tech circles and mainstream media.
